entities.summary: The Shandong Provincial Sports Centre Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium located in the Shandong Provincial Sports Centre of Jinan, Shandong, People's Republic of China. It is currently used mostly for football matches. The stadium holds 43,700 and was built in 1988.
